usedFor: Signable holds your sent envelopes and HubSpot holds your contacts, so “Send Envelope” can run “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Envelope” in Signable, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Sending a document leaves a note on the HubSpot contact, so sales can see what was sent.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so check the envelope data carries one.
